title: Powder Peak Home Inspections
description: A full-stack marketing site for a home inspection company, featuring a dynamic fee estimate calculator with admin-adjustable settings persisted in Appwrite. Integrated Next Auth for secure admin authentication, a Brevo-connected contact form, and Calendly for seamless appointment scheduling.

title: Elevated Barre Studio
description: A mobile-first marketing site for a barre fitness studio, custom designed with a focus on responsive aesthetics and seamless user experience across devices. Integrates third-party backend widgets for class scheduling, lead generation, and subscription management to deliver a full-featured business presence without a custom backend.

title: Horizon Banking App
description: A full-stack banking dashboard built featuring secure authentication, Plaid-powered bank account aggregation, and Dwolla-enabled electronic transfers. Developed as a guided project to practice integrating third-party financial APIs with a polished UI built for transaction visualization.

title: High Mountain Home Professionals
description: A clean brochure site for a home services business built for showcasing service offerings and customer testimonials. Features a contact form to drive lead generation and a responsive layout styled with custom SASS for a polished, professional look.
